note: §11: D0 PREPARES a D1 protocol and runs NO stochastic or paid model trial. Nothing here is an experimental result.

estimatedEffect.estimand: the INCREMENTAL effect of source-qualified Trajectory evidence beyond existing Context
estimatedEffect.control: Existing Canonical Work Context + Existing PriorResultContext
estimatedEffect.treatment: the SAME Context + a Source-qualified Trajectory Capsule

consumer: the existing Governed Rework / PriorResultContext path: a consumer Attempt A1 whose canonical lineage names origin Attempt A0; the Context Owner verifies the relationship, so the consumer cannot choose an arbitrary historical Attempt

taskFamilies.name: Governed Rework Continuation
taskFamilies.shape: a prior Attempt has real execution history and an observed failure or incomplete result; the consumer Attempt is a legitimate governed continuation
taskFamilies.measures: whether Trajectory helps the Agent avoid repeating historical failures and choose a more accurate next action

taskFamilies.name: Multi-Invocation Reconstruction
taskFamilies.shape: an Attempt has more than one execution Invocation with potentially different qualification and coverage states
taskFamilies.measures: whether the Agent accurately distinguishes confirmed actions, missing observations, incomplete Invocations, historical interpretation and the actual Work outcome

requirements: UQ-1 baseline neither at the floor nor the ceiling, with room to move in BOTH directions
UQ-2 at least two outcome dimensions vary under repetition of the control
UQ-3 at least one treatment-relevant failure class varies
UQ-4 the Capsule's own recorded method mechanically covers a case that varies
UQ-5 success cannot hinge entirely on one unrelated residual case
benchmarkQualificationLaw.carriedForward: all five requirements; a task that fails the law is NOT ready for a utility trial
benchmarkQualificationLaw.avoidedPriorFailure: R2-VR showed Scenario D was saturated (every trial 13/14 or 14/14) and its remaining variance was one unrelated case (h14) that no added capital addressed; D1 must not reuse Scenario C/D merely because they are easy to run

baselineOnlyCalibration.required: D1 begins with baseline-only calibration before ANY Treatment execution
baselineOnlyCalibration.method: run the control arm alone across the frozen dimensions and measure the per-dimension distribution
baselineOnlyCalibration.ifSaturated: BENCHMARK_NOT_QUALIFIED — NOT a reason to increase the number of Treatment trials

crossModelGenerality: NOT claimed unless the model-family axis is frozen before execution
consumptionProofLimits: delivery is not proof of understanding
model citation of a historical fact is not proof of correct application
self-reported model confidence is not an acceptance oracle

authorizationBoundary.d0Action: D0 created NO live-model run and wrote NO UTILITY_POSITIVE_SIGNAL anywhere
